Done.

1. **Added** [src/components/ui/loading-animation-svg.tsx](src/components/ui/loading-animation-svg.tsx) — verbatim from the CareUI registry (`LoadingAnimationSvg`). It needs a `blink` animation, so [src/style/index.css](src/style/index.css) now has `@keyframes blink` plus `--animate-blink: blink 1.5s infinite;` in `@theme`.

2. **Updated** [src/components/Common/Loading.tsx](src/components/Common/Loading.tsx) to render `<LoadingAnimationSvg />` instead of the blinking `care_logo_gray.svg`.

3. **Updated** [index.html](index.html) — the pre-bundle placeholder is now an inline, static pixel-art heart (same path geometry/rose-500 fill as the animation's heart frame), with no animation or extra network request. Dropped the now-unused `.App-logo` / `App-logo-blink` styles from both the inline `<style>` and [src/style/index.css](src/style/index.css).

Verified with `tsc --noEmit`, Prettier, and a browser render of the static heart + generated `blink` keyframes.
